title: Two Australian states to offer free transport as fuel prices rise
byline: Two Australian states will temporarily offer free public transport to ease the effects of rising fuel costs, as prolonged hostilities in the Middle East increase supply risks.

title: Police warn of burglary risks as nights get warmer
byline: The Sri Lanka Police has issued a public advisory urging homeowners to remain vigilant and take precautions to prevent burglaries during the prevailing warm weather.

title: Three arrested over school assault circulated on social media
byline: Three students have been arrested in connection with an assault involving schoolchildren in the Hatton area, after video footage of the incident circulated on social media.

title: Russia’s Deputy Foreign Minister to visit Sri Lanka
byline: Russia’s Deputy Foreign Minister Andrey Rudenko is scheduled to visit Sri Lanka on March 31, 2026, to participate in the 11th round of bilateral political consultations between Sri Lanka and the Russia.

title: Two suspects deported from India over drug trafficking links
byline: Two suspects accused of aiding a large-scale drug trafficking operation have been deported to Sri Lanka from India, police said.

title: Thousands of U.S. marines arrive in Middle East as Yemen’s Houthis join war against Israel
byline: A U.S. Navy ship carrying some 2,500 marines has now arrived in the Middle East, U.S. Central Command announced Saturday, while Houthi rebels in Yemen launched strikes on Israel.

title: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard threatens US universities in the Middle East
byline: After US-Israeli strikes destroyed two Iranian universities, Iran’s Revolutionary Guard issued a statement warning employees, professors, and students of US universities in the region to stay away from campuses.

title: Houthis threaten to choke off second vital fuel route as they target Israel in missile attack
byline: The Houthis raised the stakes in the Middle East conflict on Saturday with a threat to cripple the global economy by blocking a second vital oil shipping route.

title: Consider model similar to India’s recent fuel tax adjustment: Namal tells government
byline: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) MP Namal Rajapaksa called upon the government to consider a model similar to India’s recent fuel tax adjustment.

title: Awareness session on new online system at Colombo Port on March 31
byline: An awareness session will be held on March 31, to educate the trading community and other stakeholders on a new online mechanism aimed at preventing malpractices at the NCT Exit Gate of the Colombo Port.

title: Sri Lanka Police calls for applications for 100 legal officer posts
byline: The Sri Lanka Police has invited applications for the recruitment of 100 qualified lawyers to the position of Assistant Superintendent of Police (Legal Officers), as announced in Government Gazette No. 2477 dated February 20, 2026.

title: Sajith thanks India for supplying fuel to SL
byline: Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa thanked India for its decision to supply fuel to Sri Lanka.

title: SL could have  obtained fuel from Russia  earlier if more associated with BRICS: Namal
byline: Sri Lanka would have been able to obtain fuel from Russia much earlier if it was associated more with BRICS, the internal organization which comprises Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa, SLPP MP Namal Rajapaksa said.

title: Applications called for 453 medical officer posts
byline: The Ministry of Health has called for applications from 453 medical graduates who successfully completed their internship training on July 4, 2025, for appointments to Grade I Medical Officer positions.

title: IPL 2026: Points Table, Group Tables & Standings
byline: The IPL 2026 points table is beginning to take shape as teams battle for early momentum in the 19th edition of the tournament. The standings reflect the first shift in rankings — but with a long season ahead, every match will reshape the table.

title: IPL 2026: Results, Scores & Match by Match Summary
byline:
The IPL 2026 season is officially underway, running from March 28 to May 31, 2026, featuring 10 teams competing across 70 league matches followed by playoffs and the final.

This page tracks every IPL 2026 result, full scores, and match-by-match summaries, updated throughout the tournament to give you a complete, evergreen record of the season.

title: Pakistan secures Iran deal to send 20 ships through Strait of Hormuz
byline: Iran has agreed to allow 20 Pakistani-flagged vessels to transit the Strait of Hormuz, in what Islamabad has called a meaningful step towards easing one of the worst energy crises in modern history.

title: ’Grateful for India’s swift support’: President
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake said he is grateful for India’s swift support in supplying 38,000 MT of fuel.

title: ’Remember these two criminals’: Iran names US officers responsible for Minab school strike
byline: Iran on Sunday named US Navy Officers Commander Leigh R Tate and Executive Officer Jeffrey E York of the USS Spruance, as responsible for a missile strike on a school in Minab which claimed 168 lives.

title: “Surakimu Lanka” national programme launched for energy security
byline: The national programme titled “Surakimu Lanka”, designed to encourage the public to use energy sparingly, was officially launched today, President’s Media Division (PMD) said.

title: Tehran says army is ‘waiting’ for US ground invasion and vows to set Trump’s troops ‘on fire’
byline: Iranian armed forces are waiting for a ground invasion by US troops and are ready to “set them on fire and punish their regional partners forever” speaker of Iran’s parliament, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said on Sunday.

title: Technical officer arrested for Rs. 50,000 bribe
byline: A Technical Officer attached to the Welisara Sub-Office of the Wattala Pradeshiya Sabha was arrested by officials from the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) on charges of soliciting and accepting a bribe.

title: Two new suspects arrested over foiled Bank of America bomb plot in Paris
byline: French police have arrested two more people over an apparent bid to place a homemade explosive device outside the Paris headquarters of Bank of America, prosecutors told AFP on Sunday.

title: Pakistan hosts regional powers for Iran talks, with focus on Hormuz proposals
byline: Pakistan ​hosted talks with Turkey, Egypt and Saudi Arabia on Sunday as part of its efforts to broker ‌an end to the Iran war, with initial discussions focused on proposals to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to shipping, sources familiar with the matter said.
